entry.title: 11-Min Deep Core & Stability Workout | No Crunches

media:group.media:title: 11-Min Deep Core & Stability Workout | No Crunches
media:group.media:description:
Build a stronger brace and improve trunk control with this 11-minute deep core and stability workout. No crunches needed.
Get FREE Workout Plans: https://www.midasmvmt.com/free-workouts
Sign up for the MIDASMVMT™ App waitlist: https://subscribepage.io/spMXSa
This follow-along core session is focused on control, stability, breathing, and keeping your midline strong through every movement. You’ll move through 2 rounds of stability-focused exercises using a 40 seconds on, 20 seconds off format, with a 60-second rest between rounds.
The goal is not speed. Focus on staying controlled, breathing behind the brace, and keeping your core locked in through every hold, march, and plank variation.
Workout Details: Target: Deep core and stability Length: Approx. 11 minutes Equipment Needed: Single dumbbell Format: 40s work, 20s rest Rounds: 2 rounds Rest: 60s between rounds
Exercises: Suitcase Carry March Side Plank Bear Hold Hill Climbers
Timestamps: 00:00 Intro
Training Notes: Stay solid through your trunk, keep your neck neutral, and own the position before chasing speed or intensity. If needed, use a standing suitcase hold instead of marching, take the bear hold down to tabletop, or use a modified side plank variation.

media:group.media:title: 11-Min Standing Abs & Core Burner
media:group.media:description:
Challenge your core with this beginner-friendly 11-minute standing abs and core burner. No floor work needed.
Get FREE Workout Plans: https://www.midasmvmt.com/free-workouts
Sign up for the MIDASMVMT™ App waitlist: https://subscribepage.io/spMXSa
This quick standing core burner is built for anyone who wants an effective abs workout without getting on the floor. You’ll move through 5 standing core exercises for 2 rounds using a 40 seconds on, 20 seconds off format, with a 60-second rest between rounds.
Dumbbells are only needed for 2 of the 5 exercises, so you can keep this simple, controlled, and easy to follow at home.
Workout Details: Target: Standing abs and core Length: Approx. 11 minutes Equipment Needed: Dumbbells optional for 2 exercises Format: 40s work, 20s rest Rounds: 2 rounds Rest: 60s between rounds
Exercises: Standing Knee to Elbow Crunch Dumbbell Oblique Crunch Squat Hold with Front Reach Dumbbell Suitcase March High Knees
Timestamps: 00:00 Intro & Overview 00:29 Standing Knee to Elbow Crunch 02:09 Dumbbell Oblique Crunch 03:09 Squat Hold with Front Reach 04:09 Dumbbell Suitcase March 05:09 High Knees 06:09 Standing Knee to Elbow Crunch - Round 2 07:49 Dumbbell Oblique Crunch - Round 2 08:49 Squat Hold with Front Reach - Round 2 09:49 Dumbbell Suitcase March - Round 2 10:49 High Knees - Round 2
Training Notes: Stay tall, brace your core, and use strong exhales through every movement. Keep the reps clean and controlled instead of rushing. This should burn, but your form should stay sharp.

media:group.media:title: 10-Min Aesthetic Back & Biceps Dumbbell Finisher
media:group.media:description:
Build your back and biceps with this 10-minute aesthetic dumbbell finisher.
Get FREE Workout Plans: https://www.midasmvmt.com/free-workouts
Sign up for the MIDASMVMT™ App waitlist: https://subscribepage.io/spMXSa
This short upper-body finisher is focused on back thickness, biceps volume, and a clean final pump using dumbbells only. You’ll move through back and biceps exercises with controlled reps, tight form, and enough intensity to finish your session strong without turning it into a long workout.
Use moderate dumbbells, keep your curls strict, and focus on pulling with your elbows during the row movements. This should feel like a pump-focused finisher, not a max strength workout.
Workout Details: Target: Back and biceps Focus: Tone, hypertrophy, and upper-body pump Length: Approx. 10 minutes, excluding warm-up and cooldown Equipment Needed: Dumbbells only
00:00 Intro 00:37 Bent Over Rows 02:17 Alt Hammer Curls 03:17 Reverse Flyes 04:17 Iso Hold Curl Burnout 05:17 Leaning High Rows 06:17 Bent-Over Rows 07:17 Alternating Hammer Curls 08:17 Reverse Flyes 09:17 Iso Hold Curl Burnout 10:17 Leaning High Rows
Training Notes: Keep every rep controlled, avoid swinging through the curls, and stay locked in through your back and biceps. Pull with intent, squeeze through the working muscles, and use the final minutes to chase a clean pump without letting your form break down.

media:group.media:title: 12-Min 3D Shoulder Cap Dumbbell Finisher
media:group.media:description:
Build rounder, more defined shoulders with this 12-minute 3D shoulder cap dumbbell finisher.
Get FREE Workout Plans: https://www.midasmvmt.com/free-workouts
Sign up for the MIDASMVMT™ App waitlist: https://subscribepage.io/spMXSa
This focused shoulder finisher targets your side delts, rear delts, and front delts using dumbbells only. The goal is to build a clean shoulder pump, improve delt shape, and add extra hypertrophy volume without needing heavy weight.
Use light to moderate dumbbells, control every rep, and avoid swinging through the movements. Keep your form sharp, control the lowering phase, and stop if anything feels sharp or pinchy in the shoulders.
Workout Details: Target: Shoulders and deltoids Focus: 3D shoulder cap, tone, hypertrophy, and pump Length: Approx. 12 minutes, excluding warm-up and cooldown Equipment Needed: Dumbbells only
00:00 Intro 01:02 Lateral Raises | Round 1 02:34 Upright Rows | Round 1 03:34 Rear Delt Raises | Round 1 04:34 Twisting Front Raises | Round 1 05:34 Lateral Raises | Round 2 06:34 Upright Rows | Round 2 07:34 Rear Delt Raises | Round 2 08:34 Twisting Front Raises | Round 2 09:34 Lateral Raises | Round 3 10:34 Upright Rows | Round 3 11:34 Rear Delt Raises | Round 3 12:34 Twisting Front Raises | Round 3
Training Notes: Keep the weight lighter than your ego wants. Focus on clean shoulder mechanics, smooth reps, and strong control through every raise. This should feel like a high-quality shoulder pump, not a max strength workout.
